findingDetails.title: Healer CLI target selection is duplicated across three entrypoints
findingDetails.evidence: runAnchorRepair, runLaneModesCli, and main each independently resolve --folder, --roots, and the default specs root at lines 643-650, 1360-1366, and 1390-1395. The upgrade-legacy fold-in calls the shared repairAnchorFile and runLaneModes helpers, so the duplication is confined to the CLI wrappers rather than the repair implementations.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Directly compared all three target-selection blocks in heal-spec-docs.cjs and searched upgrade-legacy.mjs for the fold-in calls. The three wrappers repeat target selection, while the fold-in uses the exported repair helpers.
findingDetails.recommendation: Consider sharing the folder/root target-selection helper across the three CLI wrappers, with one CLI-level contract test covering each entrypoint.
findingDetails.claim: Three healer CLI entrypoints copy the same folder/root target-selection rule, creating three maintenance points for future selection changes.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the fold-in repeats the repair algorithms and whether the three wrappers need different target-selection rules. The fold-in reuses exported helpers; downstream document selection differs, but the folder/root resolution blocks are repeated.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The wrappers are short and operate on different repair surfaces, so the duplication may have been kept local intentionally.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the three target-selection blocks are intentionally independent and CLI tests already pin their parity, retain this as an optional duplication advisory.

searchLedger.invariant: The new CLI and compatibility tests keep fixture writes and cleanup inside disposable roots.
searchLedger.rationale: The inspected setup/teardown paths use OS temporary directories, per-test cleanup, or a temporary repository.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: heal-lane-modes and repair-derived create temporary roots; doctor compatibility suites create temporary repositories and remove them in test teardown.

searchActions.result: Temporary roots/repositories are created and cleanup callbacks remove the fixture trees.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Phase-aligned docs may still describe removed lane-mode flags or behavior differently from the dispatcher.
searchLedger.rationale: The selected references describe current folder/root/apply flags, current lane order, default dry-run, and the ignored legacy flags consistently with the code.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Directly compared the selected catalog, playbook, CLI README, and changelog text against runLaneModesCli and main.

searchActions.result: No stale lane-mode selector/JSON usage appeared; the changelog identifies --mode and --json as removed and ignored.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Changed runtime code or its focused tests may leave task identifiers or spec paths in comments.
searchLedger.rationale: A targeted comment-token scan returned no ephemeral identifiers or packet paths in the selected code and test files; a positive control found ordinary module comments in the same corpus.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No matching code-comment pattern was found in the selected source/test files.

searchActions.queryOrPath: comment scan for ADR/REQ/CHK/TASK ids and specs/system-speckit/034-spec-folder-tooling
searchActions.result: No matches; positive control matched existing MODULE comments in the scanned source/test corpus.

searchLedger.invariant: The switchable hook-gate inventory agrees with the listing test and its documentation.
searchLedger.rationale: The table has 13 configurable rows, the doctor listing test asserts 13 gates, and the README distinguishes the eight blocking pre-commit checks from the switchable subset.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The apparent 8-versus-13 count differs by scope: README counts all blocking pre-commit checks; the table and test count configurable gates across hooks.

searchActions.result: The switchable inventory and doctor output count agree; README's eight refers to blocking pre-commit sub-gates, not all configurable gates.
